gappers.catalyst: Q3 EPS/FCF miss, Cloud +103% beat, capex guide held at $195-205B (CNBC/TradingView)
gappers.catalyst_detail: Q3 out 10/28 AMC: adj EPS $2.67 vs $3.02 est (GAAP $2.12 incl $8.7B equity-securities loss), revenue $127.6B vs $128.2B, FCF -$9.07B vs -$2.7B est. Cloud +103% YoY beat; capex $51.4B (below est), FY guide held $195-205B with 2027 seen far higher.
gappers.why: Cash burn plus capex ramp reignites AI-spend ROI fears; ads/search miss outweighs Cloud strength.
gappers.impact: Volume 896k and still widening (-12% vs -9.7% earlier runs). Neocloud peers (NBIS, CRWV, IREN) also sold off on MSFT/GOOG capex read-through. Gap-downs this size tend to drift/retest; Cloud beat may attract dip buyers.
gappers.opportunity_cost: Falling knife, fails Confluence; no sane stop for 2:1 R:R. Would use 1 of 3 weekly slots. Pass.

gappers.catalyst: AI neocloud selloff after MSFT/GOOG capex miss; financing concerns (Benzinga/Invezz)
gappers.catalyst_detail: Neocloud group (NBIS, CRWV, IREN, APLD) fell premarket after Microsoft capex missed on delayed third-party capacity. Earlier overhang: CEO said some capital sources temporarily closed, Musk neocloud-financing warnings, $3.5B Citi facility debt worries. One analyst upgraded to Buy on the dip.
gappers.why: Capex delay read as execution/demand-timing risk for third-party AI capacity providers; financing fear compounds it.
gappers.impact: Premarket vol 118k, thin. Sector-wide move (CRWV/IREN same direction), so more beta than idiosyncratic; likely trades with GOOG/MSFT tape.
gappers.horizon_reason: sector sentiment shock, financing overhang unresolved
gappers.opportunity_cost: Catching a sector knife; sector momentum rule says avoid until AI-capex tape stabilises. No clean 2:1 R:R at a 7% stop. Pass.
